fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk Corp. (SNDK) recorded its worst weekly decline since July last week, and Morningstar warns of potential price declines after a 2028 price peak due to NAND oversupply.
fields.summary_ko.1: Morningstar sets SNDK's fair value at $110 per share after an 8:1 stock split, anticipating deteriorating profitability due to supply increases of over 30% annually in 2027–2029.
fields.summary_ko.2: Intensifying competition with China's Yangtze Memory Technologies (YMTC) and limited high-margin enterprise storage positioning are cited as additional weaknesses.
